intro.zh: 采集与审核简报已发布，本期未收录新论文。发布前采集与审核记录：北京时间08:04–08:10实际尝试全部12路信源。HF今日榜返回未就绪，API明确可用截至11/12；已完整复抓11/12的20篇（昨日快照6篇，新增14个晚到成员）和11/11的39篇，59个成员逐一对账，推荐日不顺延。全来源去重新发现24项：18篇arXiv论文、1篇非arXiv论文、5篇官方文章。三轮审查形成1项限定纳入、23项排除；DeCAF按11/05原发表日列为历史补录，不计今日新增论文。它以开发集反馈修改并保留提示、拓扑与工具策略等Harness候选，再在留出集评测；重复次数少、成本有权衡，不能称严格同预算优势或改进器自身进化。三路arXiv查询成功但窗口记录为0；五路RSS有55条窗口记录；GitHub检查13个仓库，窗口release为0。S2引文取得380条窗口记录、304个ID，受429和超时影响；作者源也受429限流，未取得覆盖仍为未知。UniCommerce官方日期只有11月精度，精确日和论文全文未知，不能把S2的11/01当作已核日期。60项旧元数据按官方同版本来源补齐，4项无实际变化结案；既有范围意见保留并重新绑定。18项版本/文本任务完成，跨两张任务表去重后仍有376项正文比较待办，不冒称全量重审完成。PLVR v1摘要修正原语库来源；DiscoveryRSI v1修正GPT比较组与语义判分器混淆，原数字保持。HexaShell v3新增技能策略分支及旧工具分支反证另档，当前公开v2快照保留。9项历史正文外部阻塞经18次重试仍未恢复。新增付费生成请求0。本期是实际观测时点的采集与审核简报，未收录今天新论文。
intro.en: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 sources were attempted at 08:04–08:10 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was not ready; the API explicitly reported availability through Nov 12. The complete Nov 12 board had 20 papers, including 14 late additions to yesterday’s six-paper snapshot, and Nov 11 had 39. All 59 members were reconciled without shifting recommendation dates. Across sources, 24 new identities were found: 18 arXiv papers, one other paper and five official articles. Three-round review supports one narrow inclusion and 23 exclusions. DeCAF enters historical-backlog review under its Nov 5 publication date, not today’s new-paper count. It uses development-set feedback to revise and retain Harness candidates before held-out evaluation; optimizer repeats are few and costs involve tradeoffs, so strictly cost-matched superiority or self-evolution of the improver is not established. Three arXiv searches succeeded with zero window records; five RSS feeds returned 55; checks of 13 GitHub repositories found no window releases. S2 citations yielded 380 window records covering 304 identities before rate limits and timeout; author queries were also rate-limited. Missing coverage remains unknown. UniCommerce has an official month-level November date only: its exact day and paper body remain unknown, and the S2 Nov 1 value is not treated as verified. Sixty metadata patches were checked against same-version official sources, with four no-change tasks closed; prior scope decisions are retained and rebound. Eighteen version/text tasks were completed; 376 distinct body-comparison tasks remain across the two queues. PLVR v1 receives a primitive-library provenance correction. DiscoveryRSI v1 distinguishes the GPT comparison group from its semantic judge without changing reported numbers. HexaShell v3’s skill-policy branch and counterevidence for its older tool branch are separately recorded while the public v2 snapshot remains intact. Eighteen retries recovered none of nine older externally blocked bodies. New paid generation requests: zero. This is a collection-time status bulletin, with no new papers included today.
